awin-atlanta-cutlery-corp-whiskey-rebell: In 1791 Congress placed an excise tax on whiskey to raise money to pay off Revolutionary War debt. The Whiskey Rebels used various flags during their rebellion, most quite simple with an anti-Federal theme. The most common were a white flag with red stripes and a flag bearing the inscription "Equal Taxation and no Excise  No Asylum for Traitors and Cowards."
